message.content:
Polish the LAYOUT of the native mail client in /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15 + Tailwind). ONLY edit `app/dashboard/mail/page.tsx` and files under `components/customer/mail/`. Do NOT touch lib/, other app trees, components/portal/Shell.tsx, or app/dashboard/layout.tsx (shared — don't break other pages). Read the existing mail components first.

Problems to fix (see the current state: the client has dead blank space and doesn't use the full screen):
1. **Fill the full height.** The mail client should occupy the full available viewport height with NO vertical blank space below it — the folder rail, message list, reading pane, and contact panel should all stretch to the bottom of the screen. Use a full-height flex/grid (e.g. `h-[calc(100vh-<header>)]` or `h-full` with `min-h-0` on the flex children so internal scroll works). The reading pane's "Select a message" empty state should be vertically+horizontally centered in its (full-height) column.
2. **No awkward blank space around it.** Remove any internal max-width/large padding that leaves big empty margins; the client should use the full width of the content area. The reading pane should flex-grow to absorb remaining width so there's no dead gap between the message list and the contact panel. If `app/dashboard/mail/page.tsx` currently wraps the client in the standard padded container, make THIS route render edge-to-edge/full-height (only for the mail page — do not change the shared layout). If achieving true full-bleed genuinely requires a shared-layout change, DON'T do it — instead get as close as possible within the mail page (full-height wrapper, negative margins to cancel the parent padding are acceptable if reliable) and note the limitation.
3. **Collapsible folder rail** — add a toggle button (e.g. a chevron/hamburger in the rail header) that **minimizes the folder rail** to a slim icons-only strip (or fully hidden with a re-open button), giving the message list + reading pane more room. Persist the collapsed state (localStorage). Also make the **right contact panel collapsible** the same way (a toggle to hide it and reclaim width) — many users want maximum reading width.
4. Keep it responsive (mobile already collapses list→reading) and fully on-brand (reuse existing classes/animations; don't invent undefined ones).

CRITICAL: Do NOT run `npm run build`/`next build` (it races with other agents on .next). Verify ONLY with `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "test/.*test.ts"` (clean for your files). Do NOT run git. Report exactly what you changed for full-height, the dead-space fix, and the two collapse toggles.
